FINAL IVX MEMBER CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM
REGULAR MEMBERS, VERIFIED INVESTORS, AND VIP INVESTORS

OWNER DIRECTIVE

Implement one authoritative member-classification system across:

- Landing page
- Expo mobile app
- IVX IA Chat
- Members module
- Investor CRM
- Owner Dashboard
- Autonomous Dashboard
- Transactions
- Holdings
- Deal rooms

Do not classify users based only on a selected registration role.

Classification must come from verified identity, compliance, and transaction data.

==================================================
1. CLASSIFICATION LEVELS
==================================================

LEVEL 1 — REGULAR MEMBER

Requirements:

- Basic registration completed
- Email OTP verified
- Phone OTP verified
- Terms accepted
- Privacy accepted
- Canonical member record exists
- Zero completed investment transactions

Required values:

member_tier = REGULAR
investor_status = NOT_VERIFIED
completed_transactions = 0
total_invested = 0

A regular member may express investor interest but must not be counted as a real investor.

LEVEL 2 — VERIFIED INVESTOR

Requirements:

- Regular member requirements passed
- Investor profile completed
- KYC/identity status approved
- Required tax status completed
- Investor agreement accepted
- At least one completed and verified investment transaction
- Transaction linked to the member through the authoritative transaction source

Required values:

member_tier = INVESTOR
investor_status = ACTIVE
completed_transactions >= 1
qualifying_invested_capital > 0

Do not count:

- pending transactions
- test transactions
- failed payments
- cancelled transactions
- unfunded commitments
- expressions of interest
- manually entered fake totals

LEVEL 3 — VIP INVESTOR

Requirements:

- Verified Investor status
- At least one completed transaction
- Qualifying invested capital of at least $500,000

Required values:

member_tier = VIP
investor_status = ACTIVE
completed_transactions >= 1
qualifying_invested_capital >= 500000

VIP classification must be calculated automatically from verified transaction records.

==================================================
2. AUTHORITATIVE FINANCIAL CALCULATION
==================================================

Create these values:

- lifetime_settled_investment
- current_active_principal
- committed_capital
- pending_capital
- refunded_principal
- cancelled_capital
- distributed_amount
- completed_transactions
- last_completed_transaction_at
- largest_completed_transaction

Use this default VIP calculation:

qualifying_invested_capital =
lifetime_settled_investment
- refunded_principal

Do not include:

- pending transfers
- rejected transfers
- failed payments
- cancelled investments
- test records
- soft commitments

Document whether VIP is based on:

A. Lifetime settled investment
OR
B. Current active principal

Use only one rule in production.

Recommended production rule:

VIP when lifetime settled investment minus refunded principal is at least $500,000.

==================================================
3. REQUIRED DATABASE FIELDS
==================================================

Add or verify:

members:
- id
- auth_user_id
- member_tier
- investor_status
- email_verified_at
- phone_verified_at
- onboarding_phase
- classification_updated_at
- classification_reason
- classification_version

investor_profiles:
- member_id
- kyc_status
- tax_status
- compliance_status
- investor_agreement_at
- approved_at
- restricted_at

transactions:
- id
- member_id
- offering_id
- amount
- currency
- status
- settled_at
- refunded_amount
- external_reference
- source
- is_test
- created_at

member_financial_summary:
- member_id
- completed_transactions
- lifetime_settled_investment
- current_active_principal
- refunded_principal
- qualifying_invested_capital
- largest_completed_transaction
- last_completed_transaction_at
- calculated_at

==================================================
4. TRANSACTION STATUS RULES
==================================================

Only these statuses may count as completed capital:

- settled
- completed
- funded_and_confirmed

These statuses must not count:

- draft
- interested
- reserved
- pending
- processing
- failed
- rejected
- cancelled
- refunded
- test

If a completed transaction is later fully refunded:

- reduce qualifying capital
- recalculate the member tier
- preserve the audit history
- do not delete the historical transaction

==================================================
5. AUTOMATIC CLASSIFICATION ENGINE
==================================================

Create one classification service:

classifyMember(memberId)

Required sequence:

1. Load canonical member.
2. Confirm email and phone verification.
3. Load investor compliance status.
4. Load all non-test transactions.
5. Calculate completed transaction count.
6. Calculate qualifying invested capital.
7. Determine tier.
8. Write classification reason.
9. Write classification timestamp.
10. Write audit event.
11. Update CRM and dashboards.
12. Notify affected services.

Classification rules:

IF basic verification incomplete:
    tier = PENDING

ELSE IF completed_transactions = 0:
    tier = REGULAR

ELSE IF investor approval is not active:
    tier = REGULAR
    investor_status = RESTRICTED_OR_PENDING

ELSE IF qualifying_invested_capital < 500000:
    tier = INVESTOR

ELSE:
    tier = VIP

==================================================
6. NO MANUAL UNCONTROLLED VIP ASSIGNMENT
==================================================

Do not allow staff to directly type:

member_tier = VIP

Manual override requires:

- owner authorization
- documented reason
- evidence attachment
- expiration date
- second review when configured
- immutable audit record

Manual override must never change the underlying transaction totals.

==================================================
7. DOWNGRADE AND RECALCULATION
==================================================

Recalculate classification when:

- a transaction settles
- a payment fails
- a transaction is cancelled
- principal is refunded
- KYC expires
- investor status becomes restricted
- member records are merged
- financial data is corrected

Possible outcomes:

VIP → INVESTOR
INVESTOR → REGULAR
ACTIVE → RESTRICTED

Do not silently downgrade.

Record:

- previous tier
- new tier
- reason
- qualifying total before
- qualifying total after
- actor or automated service
- timestamp
- trace ID

==================================================
8. DISPLAY RULES
==================================================

Members module:

- Regular Member badge
- Verified Investor badge
- VIP Investor badge

Owner Dashboard must show:

- total regular members
- total verified investors
- total VIP investors
- total invested capital
- VIP invested capital
- new investors this month
- members awaiting investor verification
- investors with pending transactions
- classification changes
- transaction source

Public users must never see:

- SSN
- tax ID
- passport
- exact private investment balances
- KYC documents
- compliance notes

==================================================
9. IVX IA RULES
==================================================

IVX IA must answer classification questions using authoritative data.

Examples:

“Is this person a real investor?”

Required answer:

- Yes only when completed_transactions >= 1
- Include masked transaction evidence
- Include investor status
- Include calculated classification
- Do not reveal restricted personal information

“Is this person VIP?”

Required answer:

- Yes only when qualifying invested capital >= $500,000
- Show qualifying total
- Show classification rule
- Show last calculation time
- Include evidence IDs

Do not let IVX IA infer VIP status from conversation text.

==================================================
10. QA TEST CASES
==================================================

Test these controlled accounts:

1. Verified registration, zero transactions
   Expected: REGULAR

2. Investor interest selected, zero transactions
   Expected: REGULAR

3. KYC approved, zero transactions
   Expected: REGULAR

4. One pending transaction for $100,000
   Expected: REGULAR

5. One completed transaction for $50,000
   Expected: INVESTOR

6. Multiple completed transactions totaling $499,999
   Expected: INVESTOR

7. Completed transactions totaling exactly $500,000
   Expected: VIP

8. Completed transactions totaling $750,000
   Expected: VIP

9. $600,000 completed with $150,000 refunded
   Expected qualifying total: $450,000
   Expected: INVESTOR

10. $500,000 pending only
    Expected: REGULAR

11. One test transaction for $1,000,000
    Expected: REGULAR

12. VIP investor with expired KYC
    Expected tier retained or restricted according to documented policy
    Investor access must be restricted

13. Duplicate transaction webhook
    Expected: counted once

14. Transaction replay
    Expected: rejected or idempotently returned

15. Member account merge
    Expected: totals reconciled once, no duplication

==================================================
11. SECURITY AND AUTHORIZATION
==================================================

Verify:

- member can read only their permitted classification
- non-owner cannot edit member tier
- owner edits require audit evidence
- transaction webhooks are signed
- replayed webhooks are rejected
- test records cannot affect totals
- service-role access remains backend-only
- financial totals cannot be changed from client code
- exact balances are not public
- classification route returns 401 without authentication
- unauthorized role receives 403

==================================================
12. PRODUCTION RECONCILIATION
==================================================

Audit all existing members.

Return:

- total members
- regular members
- verified investors
- VIP investors
- members with investor interest but no transaction
- investors with completed transactions
- members at or above $500,000
- duplicate transactions
- orphan transactions
- test transactions incorrectly included
- records missing member_id
- classification mismatches

Repair every mismatch safely.

Do not delete financial records silently.

==================================================
13. DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

Required sequence:

1. Inspect existing member and transaction schema.
2. Create migration.
3. Add financial summary calculation.
4. Add classification service.
5. Add transaction event triggers.
6. Add reconciliation job.
7. Add owner dashboard totals.
8. Add badges and filters.
9. Add IVX IA classification tools.
10. Add authorization.
11. Add audit events.
12. Add automated tests.
13. Run TypeScript.
14. Run lint.
15. Run backend tests.
16. Run Expo tests.
17. Run security tests.
18. Test controlled production accounts.
19. Commit to real GitHub.
20. Run CI.
21. Obtain owner deployment approval.
22. Deploy exact green SHA.
23. Verify /health and /version.
24. Verify classifications live.
25. Return production evidence.

==================================================
FINAL REPORT
==================================================

REGULAR MEMBER CLASSIFICATION:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

VERIFIED INVESTOR CLASSIFICATION:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

VIP INVESTOR CLASSIFICATION:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

TRANSACTION VERIFICATION:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

$500,000 VIP THRESHOLD:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

REFUND RECALCULATION:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

DUPLICATE PREVENTION:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

OWNER AUTHORIZATION:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

DASHBOARD:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

IVX IA MAPPING:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

DATA RECONCILIATION:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

DEPLOYMENT:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

SHA PARITY:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

FINAL STATUS:

IVX MEMBER CLASSIFICATION:
VERIFIED / PARTIAL / FAIL

PRODUCTION RELEASE:
APPROVED / NOT APPROVED

Do not call someone an Investor based only on interest.

A real Investor must have at least one completed verified transaction.

Do not call someone VIP based on profile claims.

A VIP Investor must have qualifying verified investment capital of at least $500,000.
